title: An advanced civilization made the genetic mix 1,800 years ago

tellings.quote: If you go back 1,800 years, it's crazy. It is likely that a civilization more advanced than ours made that genetic mix.

plain: A researcher named Thierry Jamin, talking on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025 about strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru, says these beings date back about 1,800 years to the Nazca region. He says it is likely that a civilization more advanced than ours created them by mixing genes, which, if true, would mean someone was doing genetic engineering long before us.
